newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fifth homeless death from cold in France.
newsitem.headline: Fifth homeless death from cold in France.

text.p: A homeless man in his 50s was found dead of cold overnight in an underground Paris parking lot, bringing to five the number of people killed in the past three days by a cold wave sweeping France, police said.

Xavier Emmanuelli, a junior minister in charge of emergency humanitarian action, said he had written to local officials across France urging them to make sure the homeless in their area were being adequately cared for during the cold weather.
